newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekend box office chart -- Aug. 8-10.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekend box office chart -- Aug. 8-10.

text.p: Following are the final data for the top 10 movies at the Aug. 8-10 box office, according to Exhibitor Relations Co.
NOTE: Last weekend's position in parentheses. * denotes new release.
"Conspiracy Theory" and "Contact" are released by Warner Bros., a unit of Time Warner Inc.
"Air Force One" and "Men in Black" are released by Columbia Pictures, a unit of Sony Corp.
"Spawn" is released by New Line Cinema, a unit of Time Warner.
"George of the Jungle," "Air Bud" and "Nothing to Lose" are from Walt Disney Co.
"Picture Perfect" is released by 20th Century Fox, a unit of News Corp.
"How To Be A Player" is released by Gramercy Pictures, a unit of PolyGram NV.
